children: Lisk users have until 24 October 2026 to start bridging assets from Lisk Chain to Ethereum. The bridge process takes about eight days, and every withdrawal must be claimed on Ethereum by the end of 2 November.

The deadline applies to assets including LSK. The eight-day bridge process leaves users who start on the final day with only a short window to claim their withdrawals before the Ethereum claim deadline.
Today is the last day to start bridging from the Lisk Chain to Ethereum.
Holding ETH, stablecoins or LSK in your wallet there?
Bridging takes about 8 days, and every withdrawal must be claimed on Ethereum by the end of 2 November.

title: Lisk: Bridge initiation window closes for transfers to Ethereum - 24 Oct 2026
